entries.title: Galatians 5:2
segments: Christ will profit you nothing. The receiving of the outward rite of circumcision is virtually a denial of the complete sufficiency of the truth as it is in Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 5:3
segments: Debtor to do the whole law. There is no middle ground. If one provision of the law (circumcision) is necessary to salvation, the whole law must be necessary.

entries.title: Galatians 5:4
segments: Severed from Christ. Through denial of the gospel. 'For Christ is the end of the law' (

entries.title: Galatians 5:8
segments: This persuasion. To assume the bondage of the law by making it of equal importance with the revelation of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 5:9
segments: A little leaven. If circumcision were accepted the whole burden of bondage to the law would be developed.

entries.title: Galatians 5:11
segments: If I still preach circumcision. This refers to the fact that Paul advised the circumcision of Timothy (
), as his mother was a Jewess.  Paul had also observed other Jewish customs (

 Stumblingblock of the cross. The great discord was in the superseding of the discipline of the Mosaic law, with its minute and hallowed observances, by faith in the teachings of One who had died the shameful death of the cross.
